audience: marketing and training teams that host and organize videos in SproutVideo

useCases.title: Check which videos are still processing
useCases.text: Filter the videos by state, such as processing or failed. Open one video to read its progress, plays and embed code.

useCases.title: Make a video public
useCases.text: Update a video's title, description, privacy or tags. Setting privacy to public lets anyone with the link view the video.

useCases.title: Create folders for a training library
useCases.text: List the folders, then create a folder at the root or inside a parent folder. Moving a folder moves its contents with it.

useCases.title: Review the playlists and tags
useCases.text: List the playlists and the tags, with the video ids tagged with each one. Read one playlist with its video list.

useCases.title: Confirm the account and live streams
useCases.text: Confirm which account the key uses, with its settings. List the live streams with their title and state.
